instructions: Read AGENTS.md first. Use it as repo map. Read full docs only on demand via grep.
Prefer grep before read. Use glob with specific pattern like 'libraries/maps-v2/crates/*/src/*.rs', never '**/*'.
Use read with offset/limit. Never read target/, node_modules/, public/packages/, public/fixtures/, dist/, *.mt2, e2e snapshots.
Always emit file_path:line refs for every code reference.
Keep diffs minimal. Verify with: cargo test --workspace (libraries/maps-v2) and npm run typecheck (applications/maps-v2-lab).
For tile format changes: bump FORMAT_VERSION in maps2-tile/src/lib.rs:52, update docs/tile-format.md, and migrate golden hash in maps2-fixtures/src/lib.rs:382.
For ingest changes: run cargo run -p maps2-ingest -- verify-package <dir> after.
Token budget: stay under 2.5k tokens bootstrap (AGENTS.md + one targeted file). Do not read README.md + architecture.md fully unless task requires narrative context.
For multi-task or long-loop work: delegate per-crate/card work to isolated subagents via task tool; controller keeps summaries only, never re-reads file subagent summarized.
Dispatch reviewer subagent between tasks; do not review diffs inline in controller (burns context).
